question: Can you provide the highest and lowest profits for Italian customers segmented into ten evenly divided tiers based on their December 2021 sales profits?
sql:
WITH italian_sales AS (
  SELECT 
    s.cust_id,
    s.amount_sold,
    c.unit_cost,
    s.quantity_sold,
    (s.amount_sold - c.unit_cost * s.quantity_sold) AS profit
  FROM sales s
  JOIN customers cu ON s.cust_id = cu.cust_id
  JOIN countries co ON cu.country_id = co.country_id
  JOIN costs c ON s.prod_id = c.prod_id AND s.time_id = c.time_id AND s.channel_id = c.channel_id AND s.promo_id = c.promo_id
  WHERE co.country_name = 'Italy'
    AND s.time_id >= DATE '2021-12-01'
    AND s.time_id < DATE '2022-01-01'
),
customer_profit AS (
  SELECT cust_id, SUM(profit) AS total_profit
  FROM italian_sales
  GROUP BY cust_id
),
tiered AS (
  SELECT 
    cust_id,
    total_profit,
    NTILE(10) OVER (ORDER BY total_profit) AS profit_tier
  FROM customer_profit
)
SELECT 
  profit_tier,
  ROUND(MIN(total_profit), 2) AS lowest_profit,
  ROUND(MAX(total_profit), 2) AS highest_profit
FROM tiered
GROUP BY profit_tier
ORDER BY profit_tier;

WITH italian_sales AS (
  SELECT 
    s.cust_id,
    s.amount_sold,
    c.unit_cost,
    s.quantity_sold,
    (s.amount_sold - c.unit_cost * s.quantity_sold) AS profit
  FROM sales s
  JOIN customers cu ON s.cust_id = cu.cust_id
  JOIN countries co ON cu.country_id = co.country_id
  JOIN costs c ON s.prod_id = c.prod_id AND s.time_id = c.time_id AND s.channel_id = c.channel_id AND s.promo_id = c.promo_id
  WHERE co.country_name = 'Italy'
    AND s.time_id >= DATE '2021-12-01'
    AND s.time_id < DATE '2022-01-01'
),
customer_profit AS (
  SELECT cust_id, SUM(profit) AS total_profit
  FROM italian_sales
  GROUP BY cust_id
),
tiered AS (
  SELECT 
    cust_id,
    total_profit,
    NTILE(10) OVER (ORDER BY total_profit) AS profit_tier
  FROM customer_profit
)
SELECT 
  profit_tier,
  ROUND(MIN(total_profit), 2) AS lowest_profit,
  ROUND(MAX(total_profit), 2) AS highest_profit
FROM tiered
GROUP BY profit_tier
ORDER BY profit_tier;
